title: Cartan trace criterion over an arbitrary characteristic-zero field
statement: Let $F$ be a field of characteristic zero [def-weil-field], let $M$ be a finite-dimensional $F$-vector space [def-weil-finite-dimensional-subspace], and let $A\subseteq\operatorname{End}_F(M)$ be an $F$-linear subspace closed under the commutator bracket [def-wf-lie-algebra]. Write $[A,A]$ for the $F$-linear span of all $XY-YX$ with $X,Y\in A$. If ordinary trace [def-weil-endomorphism-trace] satisfies $\operatorname{Tr}_M(XY)=0$ for every $X\in[A,A]$ and $Y\in A$, then $A$ is solvable: its derived sequence $D^0A=A$, $D^{n+1}A=[D^nA,D^nA]$ reaches zero.
